          node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const s=fs.statfsSync(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP,{bigint:true});if(s.bavail*s.bsize<13000000000n)throw Error("13GB disk gate");'
          timeout 30s git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin refs/notes/b106-ci-fixture:refs/notes/b106-ci-fixture
          [[ "$(git rev-parse --verify refs/notes/b106-ci-fixture)" == "$B106_CI_NOTES_COMMIT" ]]
          source_commit=1df9875a50d5ad47188d0ba4a262ea11e3e65693

        run: node docs/engineer-osint/materialize-canonical-media-history.mjs

        run: |
          node - <<'NODE'

          const p='docs/engineer-osint-dist/index.html';

          from pathlib import Path
          import re, hashlib, html

          if digest!=expected: raise SystemExit(f'V4545_BROWSER_PARITY: digest drift {digest}')
          Path('/tmp/v4545-browser-parity.txt').write_text(f'PASS sha256={digest}\n')
          print(f'V4545_BROWSER_PARITY=PASS sha256={digest}')
          PY

          const fs=require('fs');
          const p='docs/engineer-osint-dist/identity-fix-retirement-readiness-audit.json';
          const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'));
          a.browser_normalized_dom_parity=true;
          a.browser_parity_evidence_pending=false;
          a.ready_for_separate_retirement_authorization_review=true;
          fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(a,null,2)+'\n');
